scientific_integrity: Proof derives all-dimensional formula algebraically; 1030 exact finite binary rank tests and six direct state-spectrum comparisons were used as corroboration, not as a substitute for proof. Historical priority provisional pending specialist inspection.
scientific_limitations: Pure, standard unweighted qubit graph states on simple antipodally augmented n-cubes with n>=3; nonempty coordinate-parity bipartitions only; no noise or arbitrary cuts.
title: Parity-cut Schmidt spectra of antipodally augmented hypercube graph states
